forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {究|きわ}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to investigate thoroughly; to get to the bottom of
definitions.explanation: To pursue the truth or essence of something through deep study or inquiry. Emphasizes the intellectual process of thorough examination.

definitions.gloss: to master; to pursue to the utmost
definitions.explanation: To reach the highest level of skill or understanding in a field or discipline through dedicated practice and study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}める。
⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}める⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: We continued the investigation to get to the bottom of the cause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}めた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。

notes:
{究|きわ}める is a transitive ichidan verb.

ASPECT (ている):
{究|きわ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing pursuit or a state of having mastered something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [subject]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}める: to investigate / master something

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}める: to pursue the truth
- ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}める: to pursue scholarship deeply
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{究|きわ}める: to master a discipline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {究|きわ}める: to investigate deeply or master (intellectual/spiritual pursuit)
- ⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to reach the extreme or pinnacle (emphasizes the peak or limit)
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to research (academic, more neutral)
